It does not realize that canonical graph in a full-dimensional body with the original integer coordinates and orthogonal continuous blocks, or supply uniform component shape normalization and the explicit D bound.

readability: The proof uses two different coordinate placements of the same residual bodies. They need only agree in depth on each isolated component; no global equivalence of the ambient spaces is asserted. For a single component, a whole-space test simply has total mass one.
